code:
Full + diff only:
  "Restore to last night's backup"
  -> could lose a full day of real activity

Full + diff + LOG chain:
  "Restore to 2:35pm, one minute before
   the bad script ran"
  -> point-in-time, because of the log backups
caption: Only the log backup chain makes the second restore possible.
